page_title: SHU 1-2 MNU | Sheffield Utd v Manchester Utd 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90+5' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
90+2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) but poses no threat.
90+2' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mason Mount (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch for Marcus Rashford.

87' Fine attempt! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
87' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
86' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
86' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
85' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) will take the corner.
84' Here comes a substitution. Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Gustavo Hamer.
84' Erik ten Hag is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jonny Evans suffers an injury and Raphael Varane (Manchester United) comes on.
83' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
82' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Jonny Evans (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.

81' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
78' Substitution. James McAtee makes his way off the pitch and Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) comes on as his replacement.

77' 1 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) and Victor Lindelof gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top right corner. 1:2.
73' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 6:4.
72' A long through ball into the box almost gives Anthony Martial (Manchester United) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
71' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
70' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
70' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
67' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

66' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
64' Substitution. Antony did his best and is replaced by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
63' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Scott McTominay will be replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
63' Substitution. Anthony Martial (Manchester United) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rasmus Hojlund walks off.
63' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
62' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Flag up against Victor Lindelof (Manchester United). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

60' Manchester Utd slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

58' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
56' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

56' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and the score remained the same.
54' Manchester Utd take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

54' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

53' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Andre Onana makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
52' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Oliver McBurnie as he is replaced by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
49' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
49' The corner kick from Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' What a chance for Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball goes inches over the crossbar.
47' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Michael Oliver blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester Utd.

45+3' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Wesley Foderingham pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner. Manchester Utd win a corner.
45+2' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
44' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
44' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
44' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Manchester Utd.
43' A cross into the box from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is cleared.

43' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
42' Great save! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Andre Onana.
40' Sheffield Utd take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
40' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
39' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' 1 - 1 Goal! Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Andre Onana.
34' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
33' Referee Michael Oliver is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Sheffield Utd!
33' Celebrations by Sheffield Utd are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
32' Handball! A player from Manchester Utd handled the ball.
30' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

28' 0 - 1 Bruno Fernandes produces a sweet pass and picks out Scott McTominay (Manchester United) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:1!
28' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) picks up an injury.
27' Wesley Foderingham is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United). Easy save!
25' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) takes a short corner kick.

25' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Andre Onana is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Sheffield Utd manage to earn a corner.
23' 54:46 – the latest ball possession ratio.
23' The corner is swung in but Sheffield Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

22' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sheffield Utd.
22' Andre Onana (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
21' Looks like Andre Onana (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' Andre Onana is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd). Easy save!

18' Antony (Manchester United) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
17' A cross from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
17' Wonderful movement by Manchester Utd. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

16' A neat pass is well received by Antony (Manchester United), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

14' Sheffield Utd slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
13' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
12' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) jumps into a tackle and Michael Oliver signals a foul.
12' The free kick is taken by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd), but ball is cleared.
12' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd are awarded the free kick.
10' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' Antony (Manchester United) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' The game is interrupted as Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) is flagged offside.
5' Sheffield Utd are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
3' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Andre Onana.

2' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Sheffield Utd.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sheffield Utd will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
